question: In which year was MS Subbulakshmi honoured with the Bharat Ratna?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1998 **__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

M.S. Subbulakshmi was honored with the Bharat Ratna in 1998. 

 
• M.S. Subbulakshmi, born Madurai Shanmukhavadivu Subbulakshmi, was a renowned Carnatic singer.
 
• She was born on September 16, 1916, in Madurai, Tamil Nadu.
 
• Her mother, Shanmukavadiver Ammal, was a veena player, which greatly influenced her early musical exposure.
 
• She began her formal Carnatic music training at a young age.
 
• M.S. Subbulakshmi gave her first public performance at the age of 11.
 
• She gained widespread recognition for her exceptional vocal talent.
 
• She performed in various prestigious venues, both in India and internationally.
 
• Her performances included those at the United Nations General Assembly in 1966.
 
• She also performed at venues like the Edinburgh International Festival of Music and Drama, and the Royal Albert Hall.
 
• She acted in several films, most notably "Meera" (1945), where she sang devotional songs.
 
• Beyond her musical talent, she was known for her philanthropic work.
 
• She donated much of her award money to charitable causes.
 
• She performed numerous charity concerts, raising substantial funds for various needs.
 
• She received numerous prestigious awards throughout her career.
 
• These awards include the Ramon Magsaysay Award in 1974.
 
• She also received the Kalidas Samman in 1988.
 
• She was awarded the Padma Bhushan in 1954 and the Padma Vibhushan in 1975.
 
• In 1998, she was awarded the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian award.
 
• This recognition was a testament to her immense contribution to Indian classical music.
 
• She was the first musician to receive the Bharat Ratna.
 
• M.S. Subbulakshmi passed away on December 11, 2004, in Chennai.
